thinkingSteps.body: This problem can be solved using Depth-First Search (DFS) or Union-Find algorithm. We represent the given edges as an adjacency list, where each node points to its neighboring nodes. To determine whether the graph is a valid tree, we need to check two conditions: 1. The graph must be connected, i.e., there is a path between every pair of nodes. 2. There should be no cycles in the graph.
